name: @immunity-wars/art-pipeline
description: P2.4 art pipeline: keys raw generated art, trims, gates on measured contrast, emits WebP at 1x/2x/3x with a manifest that is the contract.
comment:why-a-package: The contrast gate is the check the entire token set depends on, and an instrument nobody typechecks is the known failure shape. Workspace member so typecheck and lint reach it; its negative controls run via `pnpm art:build --control`.
